name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand and resting that elbow on your inner thigh.
Let the arm hang fully extended.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm still.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A seated single-arm curl that braces the elbow against the thigh to remove swinging and isolate the biceps.
